Question B-001-006-004.

Why the correct answer is right: Amateur equipment is not certified for operation outside amateur bands, so it may not be used there as amateur gear.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "When the control operator holds an Advanced Qualification": Advanced amateur privileges do not authorize out-of-band operation with amateur equipment.
- sourceIndex 2: "When the operator already owns licensed equipment for such frequencies": Owning some licensed equipment elsewhere does not make this amateur equipment certified for those frequencies.
- sourceIndex 3: "When transmissions are limited to licence-exempt frequencies": Licence-exempt frequencies do not turn amateur equipment into compliant equipment for that service.
